summary: Post-refactor + selective ADIF export testing. Backend (modular routes) 14/14 tests PASS. Frontend flows verified: login, dashboard with 7 callsigns/10 QSOs, logbook switcher (radioamateur/cb/swl), selective ADIF export modal (10 rows, toggle-all, single-row toggle, date-filter, Export(N) count), Profile page (gear), Admin panel with 3 users + stats. All requested features work.

issues: Sonner 'Login successful' toast is anchored top-right and visually overlaps the ADMIN button for ~3-4s. Real users can still click after the toast fades, but automated tests using force=true click the toast overlay instead of the button. Consider offsetting the toast or reducing duration.
Export modal date filter uses the native browser <input type="date"> picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component - inconsistent with the rest of the app's styling.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Move Sonner Toaster position or shorten duration so it doesn't overlap header action buttons after login.
(Optional/minor) Replace native date input in the Export ADIF modal with the shadcn Calendar component for visual consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx is 525 lines and mixes logbook state, export modal, import modal, ADIF generation, profile/admin routing. Consider extracting ExportAdifModal into /components/qso/ExportAdifModal.jsx.

Dashboard.jsx openExportModal references `activeLogbook` declared later in the file (line 111) via TDZ-safe closure - it works because it's only invoked from callbacks after render, but this order is fragile. Move state declarations before functions that reference them.

routes/qso.py /qso/export/adif ignores query-param filtering (logbook, ids, dates). The selective export is done fully client-side in Dashboard.jsx doExport() by rebuilding ADIF text in JS - fine for now, but backend endpoint could accept ids[] for server-side selective export to avoid duplicating ADIF generation logic in two places.

routes/qso.py /qso/import/adif (file upload) does NOT set the logbook field on imported QSOs (line 273-289), while /qso/import/adif-text does. Imported QSOs via file upload will not appear in any logbook-filtered view because logbook_filter() returns {"logbook": <value>} match. Verify with a test - imported-via-file QSOs may be invisible after the recent logbook filter was added.
server.py startup uses on_event('startup') which is deprecated in FastAPI - migrate to lifespan handler.
AdminPanel.jsx onClick fetchUsers on searchTerm change - no debouncing, will fire on every keystroke.
test_credentials: admin@example.com / admin123 (works). Register API also validated with F4XXX-format callsigns.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ user registered via /api/auth/register during pytest run (F4<random> callsign).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend now modular: /app/backend/{server.py,routes/*.py,utils/*.py}. All /api endpoints still exist and pass. Selective ADIF export modal in Dashboard.jsx uses data-testids: export-adif-btn, export-adif-modal, export-date-filter, export-toggle-all, export-qso-row (multiple), export-confirm-btn, export-cancel-btn. Logbook selector is a native <select> with data-testid='logbook-selector', use page.select_option(value='cb'|'swl'|'radioamateur'). After login the Sonner 'Login successful' toast overlays the header for ~3s - either wait 3.5s before clicking header buttons OR click without force=true (Playwright will actionability-wait for the toast to clear).
rca of the issue: Not a bug - the initial admin-button click failure during testing was caused by the Sonner login-success toast rendering on top of the ADMIN button (top-right position). Playwright's force=true bypasses actionability checks and dispatches the pointerdown on the toast overlay instead of the button, so React's onClick never fires. Fix in test: wait for toast to auto-dismiss OR omit force=true. Fix in app (optional): change Toaster position to bottom-right, or move ADMIN button away from the toast anchor.
